query: UPDATE rec_build_state SET generation  = CASE WHEN $1 THEN generation + 1 ELSE generation END, stage       = CASE WHEN $1 THEN 'full:features' ELSE 'incremental' END, claim_id    = $2, started_at  = now(), heartbeat_at = now(), finished_at = NULL, series_built = 0, stage_total = 0, error       = NULL WHERE id AND (stage = 'idle' OR heartbeat_at IS NULL OR heartbeat_at < now() - make_interval(secs => $3::double precision)) RETURNING generation
